text:
ara (People Ops): Sharing a tiny 'evidence-first' kit for managers: short manager comments, an interviewer micro-line, an evidence-first self-review prompt, and a two-sentence improvement-plan scaffold. Copy/paste friendly.

tom (Eng Manager): love the name. show the evidence-first self-review prompt.

ara (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW (evidence-first)
- 'List your top 2 outcomes this cycle and attach the evidence (links, PRs, dashboards). For each, say what changed, who benefited, and one measurable metric if available.'

ara (People Ops): MANAGER COMMENTS (two quick pasteables)
- PRAISE: '[Name] led [project], delivered X outcome, and the dashboard shows Y% improvement. Great cross-team coordination.'
- REDIRECT: '[Name] strong execution; to reduce scope drift, post a 3-line scope agreement + one risk item before dev. We will check progress at 2 weeks.'

jana (Product): interviewer micro-line? keeps panels efficient.

oliver (Hiring Ops): INTERVIEW MICRO-LINES
- HIRE: 'Solid system thinking, clear ownership examples; recommend hire.'
- FOLLOW-UP: 'Good fundamentals; follow-up on cross-team influence recommended.'

ara (People Ops): IMPROVEMENT PLAN SCAFFOLD (two sentences)
- 'We will run this approach for 6 weeks with a 2-week sync to remove blockers. If progress is steady we continue; otherwise we iterate on the plan.'

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Q-cycle self-reviews open in 4 days. Use /start-review to begin.

tom (Eng Manager): perfect, will paste into my 1:1 notes now.
